name: MobileDict_Run
evidence: Mobile dictionary (モバイルじてん) index: 11 kana-row tabs, 5 entries per page (Table_MobileDict_Categories); B returns 0, A opens the entry page (id from the bank 3F list at $40B9, 4C:4F56 a=2); entered from 6C:59A8 = help menu entry 4

name: MobileDict_Redraw
evidence: Re-entry point after an entry page was viewed (jp from MobileDict_OnA): re-initialises LCD/window and reloads tiles, palettes, tilemap and tab sprites, then redraws the page

name: MobileDict_Loop
evidence: Per-frame loop: 00:0956, 00:044B, Joypad_UpdateIdleFrames (7D:7BA4)/7BC1, call JoypadDispatch with Table_MobileDict_Buttons; plays sound id $1A via stub 00:20E8 when the screen opens

name: Table_MobileDict_Buttons
evidence: JoypadDispatch inline table (5 words): A -> MobileDict_OnA, B -> MobileDict_OnB, Select/Start ignored (Label_1A_41E2), none -> MobileDict_Idle

name: MobileDict_Idle
evidence: No A/B/Select/Start: D-pad with repeat (hJoyPressedRepeat & $F0) handled by MobileDict_HandleDpad, then loop

name: MobileDict_OnA
evidence: A pressed: sound id $2C, fade out (4F:4370), reads the page id byte from the bank-3F list of category wRam_C0D4 at row wRam_C0D6 + scroll wRam_C0E5 and opens that dictionary page with 4C:4F56 (a=2, bc=id); then redraws

name: MobileDict_OnB
evidence: B pressed: sound id $2E via stub 00:20AC, fade out, return A=0 (cancel)

name: MobileDict_HandleDpad
evidence: Up/Down move the row cursor wRam_C0D6 (1-5) and scroll offset wRam_C0E5; Right/Left change category wRam_C0D4 (1-11, wraps); each move plays sound id $29 and redraws

name: MobileDict_CursorUp
evidence: Up: row cursor wRam_C0D6-1 with sound id $29 and MobileDict_DrawRowHighlight; at the top row falls to MobileDict_ScrollUp

name: MobileDict_ScrollUp
evidence: Cursor at row 1: scroll offset wRam_C0E5-1 (if > 0), sound $29, MobileDict_LoadPage + DrawRowHighlight + UpdateTabSprites; only the offset==0 early return ran in traces, the scrolling itself never executed

name: MobileDict_CursorDown
evidence: Down: row cursor +1 up to 5 and up to the entry count wRam_C0D8, sound $29; at row 5 falls to MobileDict_ScrollDown; returns at the last entry

name: MobileDict_ScrollDown
evidence: Cursor at row 5: scroll offset wRam_C0E5+1, sound $29, reload page, highlight and tab sprites

name: MobileDict_NextCategory
evidence: Right: category wRam_C0D4+1 (11 wraps to 1), row 1, scroll 0, reload page, sound $29

name: MobileDict_PrevCategory
evidence: Left: category wRam_C0D4-1 (1 wraps to 11), row 1, scroll 0, reload page, sound $29

name: MobileDict_DrawRowHighlight
evidence: Copies the 5-row entry text buffer ($D4A1) to VRAM tiles and highlights the row wRam_C0D6 (00:091C, bc=$0A10 / $0210)

name: MobileDict_UpdateTabSprites
evidence: Places the category tab marker (slot $DA40, x from Table_MobileDict_TabPositions[wRam_C0D4]) and the up/down scroll arrows (slots $DA20/$DA30) depending on scroll position and count wRam_C0D8

name: Table_MobileDict_TabPositions
evidence: 11 (index, x) byte pairs: x = 8 + 12*index; tab marker sprite x position for category 1-11 (read)

name: MobileDict_LoadPage
evidence: Clears the text tile buffer (WRAM bank 2) and renders up to 5 entry names of category wRam_C0D4 from offset wRam_C0E5 with TextTiles_RenderGridRows (48:415A) (text to tiles), then uploads them to VRAM $9000/$9400/$8800
